## Reaper Control 2.1.0

Easier setlists, titles that stay put, a live system view, and Reaper Control that starts by itself with a project.

### Start with a project
- A new switch, **Start with this project**, sits in the sidebar (above Performer mode) and in Settings. When you open a REAPER project that has it on, REAPER starts Reaper Control if it is not running yet. The choice is saved in the project, so every project decides for itself. It is off by default, and Reaper Control is never closed by it.
- This needs the new REAPER extension (1.0.7). The app notices that the installed one is older: open the setup from the sidebar and let it update, then restart REAPER. Open the app once after that, so REAPER knows where it is.

### Setlists
- **A screen with a card for every setlist**: how many songs and how long, the first songs, and buttons to edit, play and delete, plus a tile to make a new one.
- **Editing a setlist has its own screen with two columns**: the songs in the setlist on the left, the songs in the REAPER project on the right. **Drag** a song across to the spot you want, or press **+**; drag songs in the list to reorder them; ✕ removes one. Leaving songs out is fine, a shorter set needs no warning. Only a song that is in the setlist but no longer in the project is flagged.
- Leaving with unsaved changes asks first. **Play this setlist** goes straight to the Player.

### Titles
- A long song name no longer makes the Player jump. The title stays on one line and **slides**, like a radio display: the start for a moment, then to the end of the name, then again. The same in Performer mode, for the current song and the next one.

### System view
- The connection and health dialog (click "REAPER connected" in the sidebar) now **updates live** and shows **bars** next to the numbers: machine CPU and memory, and the memory of the app and of REAPER.

### Known issues
- After a REAPER crash the extension stays disabled until you remove the `faulted` and `running` files in the `RC2` folder of the REAPER resource path (Windows: `%APPDATA%\REAPER\RC2`). The app has no re-enable button yet.
- On Windows, "Start with this project" can open a second Reaper Control when the first one is slow to reconnect after REAPER starts. Close the extra window.
- The app is not code-signed.
